structured.answer: Harel has like 96 tracks; the one that made sense to me is the S&P 500 tracker — about 0.56% fee in קופת גמל להשקעה (0.5% in קרן השתלמות) and about 13.7% a year over 3 years — so that's what I'd look at, but I still don't know what the fee is in shekels or which product to open first.
